programme.desc: Sabrina knows there’s a big assignment due at school - a term paper on a world conqueror. (She chose Attila the Hun, thinking he’d been given a raw deal by history; she’s going to tell the true story.

programme.title: Class of the Titans: Bows & Eros

programme.title: Class of the Titans: Road to Hades

programme.title: Class of the Titans: Many Happy Returns

programme.title: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: All the Gory Details!

programme.sub-title: No Time to Be a Hero

programme.title: Sabrina The Animated Series: Extreme Harvey

programme.title: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: Dead Men Don't Jump!

programme.title: My Goldfish is Evil: Lights, Camera, Goldfish!

programme.title: My Goldfish is Evil: Ghostfish!

programme.title: My Goldfish is Evil: A Schoolplay Named Disaster!

programme.title: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: The Brothers Gruff
